jobfinder.name: Merey Job Finder
jobfinder.text: A Telegram bot that searches vacancies on hh.kz by the user's profile: position, skills, city or remote work, salary and experience.
features: Shows a skills-match percentage on every vacancy card, with the skills the user already has and the ones to learn.
Keeps a list of favourite vacancies.
Sends a daily digest of new vacancies, without repeats, at a time the user chooses.

privacy.heading: Privacy
items: The form collects only what you type: your name, an optional reply contact and your message. The page language and the time of sending are saved together with them.
I use this only to read your message and to reply. It is not passed to anyone else and is not used for advertising.
Messages are kept in a file on the hosting that cannot be opened from the web, and I delete them after replying. To have a message removed sooner, ask through the same form.

To limit spam, the server keeps a salted hash of the sender's network address. The hash is used for 30 seconds and is deleted or replaced when the next request reaches the form after that, so when nobody visits it stays in the file longer. The address itself is never stored.
The code of this site sets no cookies, has no analytics and loads nothing from third parties. The language choice is remembered only in your own browser and is not sent to the server.
The hosting provider (InfinityFree) sets one technical cookie named __test to check that your browser runs JavaScript. It is set by the host, not by this site, and I do not use it.
